pages.text: Tide brings new rods, more than a hundred new fish, and a $(l:food/tide#fishing_journal)Fishing Journal$(/l) that remembers every catch.

Fish keep to their own waters, depths and weather. When one bites, a bar appears: click on the light zone and it's yours, on the dark zone and it's gone. Hooks and lines go on at the $(l:food/tide#angling_table)Angling Table$(/l), and $(l:food/tide#bait)Bait$(/l) goes in the rod.
Tide's own rods, $(l:food/tide#crystal_fishing_rod)Crystal$(/l) among them, last longer than plain ones. Your $(l:food/fishing)Aquaculture$(/l) rods still work.
